title: Clinical Specialist Trach Emilia-Romagna e Lombardia
INFERMIERE/A LIBERO PROFESSIONISTA A VENEZIA E PROVINCIA
description:
Human AssistCare è il nuovo marchio commerciale con cui Italiassistenza S.p.A, Home Care Company, si occupa in Italia di programmi a sostegno dell'aderenza alla terapia in un’ottica win win, che permette di non gravare sul SSN e di migliorare sensibilmente la qualità di vita dei pazienti e delle loro famiglie. La società opera tramite le sue sedi di Milano, Reggio Emilia e Lugano, che coordinano una rete capillare di medici, infermieri e di centri di assistenza domiciliare accreditati.
  
  

Human Assist Care è il leader italiano dei Patient Support Program, adottati alle Aziende Farmaceutiche per le patologie croniche e rare, in cui si abbina al farmaco un processo gestionale e educazionale che coinvolge il paziente, il suo caregiver e il medico curante.
  
  

Human Assist care è inoltre specializzata nella gestione, erogazione e monitoraggio di servizi di assistenza infermieristica, medica e socioassistenziale, anche mediante l’impiego di strumenti di telemedicina, con la possibilità di abbinare i servizi alla persona a domicilio o in azienda.
  
  

Migliorare la qualità di vita dei nostri pazienti e delle loro famiglie è la nostra mission quotidiana. La qualità dei nostri servizi e la professionalità dei nostri operatori sono i princìpi a cui ci ispiriamo.
  
  

**INFERMIERE/A LIBERO PROFESSIONISTA A VENEZIA E PROVINCIA:**  

**Mansioni:**  

* Effettuare al domicilio prestazioni sanitarie infusionali, educazionali o diagnostiche conformi ai protocolli operativi e agli standard di legge
* Segnalare eventi o reazioni avversi in ambito della farmacovigilanza
* Eseguire le attività con efficacia ed efficienza nei diversi contesti di assistenza infermieristica
* Controllo e supporto all’aderenza terapeutica del Paziente
* Agire in maniera conforme al Codice Deontologico di riferimento


**Requisiti:**  

Laurea in Infermieristica o diploma equipollente
  
  

* Iscrizione all’Ordine delle Professioni Infermieristiche
* Assicurazione Professionale
* Essere In regola con i crediti ECM
* Attestazione BLSD in corso di validità
* Automunito
* Disponibilità a spostamenti sulla provincia
* Buona padronanza degli strumenti informatici
* Professionalità e puntualità


**Offerta:**  

* Contratto di collaborazione a p.iva
* Rimborso chilometrico

description:
**Summary**

This position is located at USAG Italy \- MWR, Ederle Fitness Center Pool, Vicenza, Italy.  

  

**Incentives and Bonuses**


* Incentives will not be paid.

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

United States (U.S.) Citizens and Non\-U.S. Nationals who have resided in the U.S. or U.S. territory for three (3\) or more continuous years immediately preceding the start of Federal affiliation. **Duties**
----------


* Serves as a lifeguard for indoor and outdoor pools and works under the direction of the Installation Aquatics Program Manager. Employs safety rules for the protection of the pool guests.
* Responsible for lifeguarding guests in attendance at the assigned aquatics facility. Provides maximum pool area surveillance and responds to emergencies; rescues pool patrons and administers first aid as required.
* Responsible for assisting in the conduct of aquatic swimming and water survival training according to ATP 7\-22\.01 as of October 2020 and assisting with American Red Cross swim lessons as an Aide.
* Assists in maintaining pool, and area clean and free from any hazards. Performs periodic water tests and reports results to the pool leader on duty.
* Attend aquatics and/or safety training as directed. Adheres to Customer Service standards of the Installation. Provides information to swimmers regarding safety/health/admission rules and procedures.

* Must have current health assessment that documents good physical health, and free from communicable disease IAW current Army Policy.
* Must be able to obtain within 30 days and maintain the following certifications: Lifeguarding, First Aid and CPR/AED from a nationally recognized agency.
* Continuous exposure to sun and prolonged periods of high temperature and humidity. In case of exposure to infectious disease, incumbent is required to obtain the Hepatitis B vaccination series within a 24\-hour period.
* Lifeguards must have good vision (based upon an acceptable standard of 20/40 vision or better, either (with glasses or contacts) or uncorrected) while on duty to effectively recognize all emergencies, incidents and rule breaking.
* Incumbent is required to follow environmental safeguards and wear personal protective equipment. May be assigned to irregular duties or when needed for special recreational events and related requirements.
* Fifteen(15\) year old lifeguards must comply with the restriction of the DOL Child Labors Law (Jan 17, 2006\).
* Subject to satisfactory completion of all pre\-employment checks in accordance with AR 215\-3, para.2 to include a T\-CNACI Childcare National Agency Check background investigation.

### **Qualifications**


**Resumes must be two pages (or less).** Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position.  

  

**A qualified candidate must possess the following:**


* Possesses and maintains the following certifications: Lifeguarding and First Aid (American Red Cross or nationally recognized equivalent i.e. Star Guard, YMCA, or ELLIS).
* American Red Cross "Cardio\-Pulmonary Resuscitation for the Professional.
* CPR for the Professional Rescuer/AED or equivalent (American Heart Association CPR/AED); First Aid.
* For Water Parks upgrade the certification to: 'Waterpark Lifeguarding and First Aid; CPR/PR/AED' (American Red Cross).
* In addition, for facilities that use Oxygen Administration "O2 bottles" the O2 Administration certification (American Red Cross "Oxygen Administration or installation offered training (i.e. Fire Dept.) must be obtained within two weeks of reporting for duty.

This job does not have an education qualification requirement.

title: Sports and Fitness Director (CYS) NF-04
description:
**Summary**
-----------


This position is located at Vicenza, Italy.  

  

**Child and Youth Services (CYS) Employee Childcare Fee applicable to employees working at least 15 hours per week**:


* First Child: 100% childcare fee discount (all CYS employees)
* Second and Subsequent Child: 25% childcare fee discount (all CYS employees)

**PCS Costs**
* Payment of Permanent Change of Station (PCS) costs may be authorized based on a determination that a PCS move is in the Government's interest.

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

Open Europe Wide, to US Citizens and Non\-US Citizens of a NATO Country except Italy eligible for employment under US conditions.


  
**Duties**
----------


* Under the direction of the installation CYS coordinator, serves as a Sports and Fitness (S/F) Director with overall responsibility for the operation, integration, coordination, and oversight of a comprehensive CYS Sports and Fitness Program.
* Responsible for the development of a broad volunteer program which includes recruiting, training, certifying, and managing coaches and officials for various sports.
* Ensures staff and volunteers follow risk management procedures (i.e., abuse prevention, identification, and reporting procedures; accident prevention, etc.). Monitors adult/participant ratios to ensure proper staffing policies are enforced.
* Initiates and maintains necessary relationships with local schools, community agencies and other like groups. Develops and maintains partnerships beneficial to CYS program participants.
* Serves as Subject Matter Expert on installation Child and Youth Services sports and fitness issues. Prepares reports, surveys, and briefings for command and installation on matters pertaining to CYS.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* Direct Deposit and Social Security Card is required.
* Meet qualification/eligibility/background requirements for this position.
* A one\-year probationary period may be required.
* Subject to satisfactory completion of all pre\-employment checks in accordance with AR 215\-3, para.2 to include a Child Care Tier 1 background investigation.
* Must complete a health assessment including all required immunizations. Must possess and maintain the physical ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs, walk, bend, stoop, and stand on a routine basis.
* Must obtain/maintain certification in CPR/First Aid.
* Must obtain (within 6 months of employment) and maintain certification as a Youth Sports Administrator through the National Alliance of Youth Sports.

### **Qualifications**


**Resumes must be two pages (or less).** Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position.  

  

**A qualified candidate must possess the following:**  

  

Possess a bachelor's degree or higher in physical education,  

  

**OR**  

  

All of the following equivalent in scope and complexity to the next lower grade level.  

1\. At least one year of experience as a director or assistant director of a child/youth or sports and fitness or physical education program which included a variety of individual and team sports.  

2\. Experience applying nationally\-recognized requirements (i.e., NAYS, NYS, NYSCA) to recruit, train, and manage coaches for various sports, or experience coaching multiple youth sports.  

3\. Experience in delivering or demonstrated knowledge of requirements for age\-appropriate health and fitness programs for children/youth.  

4\. Experience in developing partnerships with schools, community organizations, or similar.  

  

**In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified":**  

Recommended highly\-qualifying: In addition to the above, highly qualified candidates will possess a master's degree or two years of graduate\-level education which included substantial coursework directly related to children or youth (i.e., PE for children, motor skills development, childhood development, early/elementary/secondary education, health/nutrition for children, child/adolescent psychology, etc.), **OR** At least two years of experience in directing a child/youth sports and fitness or physical education program for children and youth.


### **Education**


Proof of education is required at the time of application. **Note: Education must be directly related to the position to be filled. General Education courses do not count toward the credit total.**


### **Additional information**


**Area of Consideration**


* This job is open to candidates who are currently residing in Europe (Military Spouse Preference (MSP) and Involuntarily Separated Military Preference (ISMP) eligible candidates are included in the area of consideration.)

**Incentives and Bonuses**
* Incentives will not be paid.

* This job is part of a pay\-banded system. Sunday premium pay for regularly scheduled employees and night differential pay may be authorized by the Garrison Commander.
* Foreign overseas allowances, Post Allowance and differentials may be paid, contingent upon eligibility.
* Employment overseas provides a lot of additional benefits and entitlements. For information please contact CHRA NAF C2SC \- Recruitment Branch at usarmy.apg.chra\-hqs.mbx.naf\-central\-recruitment@army.mil.
* Applicants must comply with the Exceptional Family Member Program. For more information, go to https://www.militaryonesource.mil/special\-needs/efmp/.

**Healthcare Access and Availability:**
* If an employee brings a child to an overseas location and that child is entitled to attend a DoD school on a space\-required basis in accordance with DoDEA Regulation 1342\.13, the DoDEA and the Military Department responsible for providing related services will ensure that the child, if eligible for special education, receives a free appropriate public education, including related services pursuant to DoDI 1342\.12 and DoDM 1342\.12\.
* If an employee brings an infant or toddler (up to 3 years of age) to an overseas location, and that infant or toddler, but for the child's age, is entitled to attend the DoDEA on a space\-required basis in accordance with DoDEA Regulation 1342\.13, then the Military Department responsible for Early Intervention Services (EIS) will provide the infant or toddler with the required EIS in accordance with the eligibility criteria consistent with DoDI1342\.12 and DoDM 1342\.12\.
* Employees (and family members) who require medical or dental care in the overseas location will be responsible for obtaining and paying for such care. Access for civilian employees and their families to military medical and dental treatment facilities is on a space\-available and reimbursable basis only.
